sentences.text: Shri Sameer Verma - Advocate for the appellant.

Shri Surendra Kumar Gupta - Govt. Advocate for the resp Heard on I.A. No.2613/2024, which is first application under Section 430 of BNSS, 2023 [389 of Cr.P.C] for suspension of jail sentence moved on behalf of appellant-Sunny.

3. Appellant has been convicted for offence under Sections 363, 366, 376(2) of IPC, and sentenced to undergo 5 years, 5 years and 20 years R.I with fine of Rs.1,000/-, Rs.1,000/- and Rs.3,000/- with usual default stipulations.
4. As per prosecution case it is alleged that the appellant has abducted a minor girl and also committed rape with her.
5. Learned counsel for the appellant argued that the prosecutrix had gone with the appellant herself and stayed for about 63 days.
As per the prosecution, the age of the prosecutrix on the date of the incident is 16 years, 6 months and 20 days.
Prosecution has failed to prove the source of recording of the age of the prosecutrix in the scholar registrar.

In support of his submissions, counsel has placed reliance upon the case of Tiju Bai @ Omwati Bai Vs. State of Madhya Pradesh reported in 2025 Vol.1 MPLJ (Criminal), 75.
5.

entities.text: Tiju Bai @ Omwati Bai Vs. State of Madhya Pradesh reported in 2025 Vol.1 MPLJ (Criminal), 75
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the respondent/state opposed the prayer on the ground that the age of the prosecutrix is less than 17 years.

6. After hearing counsel for the parties and considering the testimony of the prosecutrix from which it is clear that she was a consenting party, so also the fact that prosecution has failed to prove the source on the basis of which date of birth of 2 CRA-2106-2024 the prosecutrix was recorded in the scholar registrar, the appeal is of the year 2024 and final hearing of appeal will take considerable long time; Division Bench in the case of Tiju Bai @ Omwati Bai Vs. State of Madhya Pradesh reported in 2025 Vol.1 MPLJ (Criminal), 75 held that if the age of the prosecutrix in the school Sunny vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/124330951/
1 register is recorded on guess work of the person, who made entry of date of birth, the same is not sufficient to prove the age of prosecutrix and considering the same, we are of the view that the present application deserves to be allowed.

entities.text: Tiju Bai @ Omwati Bai Vs. State of Madhya Pradesh reported in 2025 Vol.1 MPLJ (Criminal), 75
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 7. Accordingly, I.A. No.2613/2024 is allowed.

The jail sentence of appellant - Sunny is suspended upon his depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited, and on furnishing a bail bond of Rs.50,000/-(Rupees fifty thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 26.11.2025 and on subsequent dates as may be fixed in this behalf by the Registry.
8. With the aforesaid, I.A is allowed and disposed of.
9. I.A. No.19121/2024, which is an application for urgent hearing also stands disposed off.
C.C. as per rules.
(VIJAY KUMAR SHUKLA)
